deleteAccount.description: This page explains how to delete your SiteNear account and how your data will be handled after deletion.

steps.title: Account Deletion Steps
steps.intro: To delete your SiteNear account, please follow these steps:
steps.step1: Log in to your SiteNear account
steps.step4: Confirm your intention to delete the account
steps.cannotLogin: If you cannot log in to your account, please contact us via email:
steps.contactSupport: If you have any questions about deleting your account, please contact:

dataHandling.title: Data Handling After Deletion
dataHandling.intro: After deleting your account, the following data will be deleted:
dataHandling.accountInfo: Account information (email address, Google login information)
dataHandling.projectData: All project data (project names, space markers, task markers)
dataHandling.issueTracking: Issue tracking records and repair records

retention.title: Data Retention Period
retention.description: After deleting your account, no data will be retained. Your account and all related data will be permanently deleted.

notes.title: Important Notes
notes.note1: After deleting your account, you will not be able to recover the account or related data
notes.note2: After deleting your account, all data associated with the account will be permanently deleted
notes.note3: If you have an active subscription, please cancel your subscription before deleting your account

deleteAccount.description: 本頁面說明如何刪除您的 SiteNear 帳戶，以及刪除後的資料處理方式。

steps.title: 刪除帳戶步驟
steps.intro: 若您要刪除 SiteNear 帳戶，請依照以下步驟操作：
steps.step1: 登入您的 SiteNear 帳戶
steps.cannotLogin: 若您無法登入帳戶，請透過電子郵件聯絡我們：
steps.contactSupport: 若有任何關於刪除帳戶的問題，請聯絡：

dataHandling.title: 刪除後的資料處理
dataHandling.intro: 刪除帳戶後，以下資料將被刪除：
dataHandling.accountInfo: 帳號資訊（電子郵件地址、Google 登入資訊）
dataHandling.projectData: 所有專案資料（專案名稱、空間標記、工項標記）
dataHandling.issueTracking: 問題追蹤紀錄與修復紀錄

retention.title: 資料保留期間
retention.description: 刪除帳戶後，不保留任何資料。您的帳戶及所有相關資料將被永久刪除。

notes.title: 注意事項
notes.note1: 刪除帳戶後，您將無法恢復帳戶或相關資料
notes.note2: 刪除帳戶後，所有與該帳戶關聯的資料將被永久刪除
notes.note3: 若您有進行中的訂閱，請先取消訂閱再刪除帳戶
